text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a cluster of deferred-edge events in the eu shard backfill. Recompute ran but skipped keys where prefix KV never materialized, so aggregates are missing for ~12h. Anyone looking at edges?

sam: yikes. which backfill run id?

maya: run=rb/2026-03-18-17, console shows a lot of `DEFERRED_EDGE` markers. sample log: `ingest-replayer: key=tenant:42:edge:12345 state=deferred reason=missing-prefix-kv`

devon: I saw similar in us-west last week. Root cause was a routing fallback that sent those early requests to the gpu-pool with an older model variant that didn't write prefix cache. Might be the same pattern.

tori: can we confirm if this is ingestion-level or replay-only? If it's ingestion we need a hotfix, replay we can schedule a targeted recompute slice.

maya: looks replay-only for this run. Ingest is fine, events landed in raw but replayer's routing policy used `fallback=compat-old` for ~30m during a capacity ripple.

sam: ok — short-term: we should rehydrate prefix-kv for affected keys and re-run the recompute. Long-term: prevent routing fallback from picking variants that change cache semantics.

devon: agree. proposal: 1) rehydrate job that reads raw events and writes prefix-kv for edges with status=deferred, 2) replay those keys via the console backfill UI with `allow-late-edges=true` flag.

maya: +1. For (1) we can reuse the existing rehydrate pipeline but need a filter on `deferred` marker to avoid full rehydration. I'll draft a job.

tori: also add quota guard — we don't want the rehydrate to blast production KV; throttle to 200 qps and set tenant fair-share.

devon: noted. Also adding a console checkbox to the backfill modal: "Treat deferred edges as reprocessable (may change aggregates)" with tooltip about quotas & expected cost.

sam: UX thought: default off, but if user checks it we surface a rough cost estimate (tokens / compute hours) and a preflight dry-run showing sample keys.

maya: can we get a quick query to enumerate affected tenants so SRE can pre-approve quota for those? something like: `SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM backfill_events WHERE run='rb/2026-03-18-17' AND state='deferred' GROUP BY tenant;`

tori: I can run that and DM the list. Also: protect the rehydrate with a flag in the operator: `--allow-deferred-rehydrate` so we can centrally toggle.

devon: I'll own the rehydrate job. Will push a small worker that scans `deferred` markers and writes prefix KV, with idempotency checks. ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: rehydrate-worker v0.3 scheduled to canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC (team: devon).

sam: next: console change — I'll file a tiny RFC for the "allow-late-edges" checkbox + cost estimator widget. Will include text: "Reprocessing deferred edges can change aggregates; recommended to run in canary and validate with the sample set."

maya: please tag me on the RFC. After rehydrate & replay, we'll run regen and diff aggregate reports to confirm.

tori: action items: devon -> implement worker, sam -> RFC/console UX, maya -> orchestration plan + run the enumerator, me -> quota approvals and throttle profile. I'll reserve daily 10m sync until this is done.

devon: filing bug: #4821 - "replayer: handle deferred-edge rehydrate and replay" and assigning to myself.

maya: thanks. quick check: is there any risk to live traffic if backfill hits the same KV shards?

tori: low if we follow the throttle and fair-share. But we'll also set ephemeral routing to route replays to dedicated replayer nodes (console flag `target=replayer-dedicated`) so we avoid CPU interference.

sam: nice. last item: telemetry — we should surface a new metric `backfill.deferred_edges_reprocessed` and a health dashboard panel so PMs can see scope.

maya: agreed. devon, add the metric in the PR.

devon: will do. I'll post PR link when ready and request canary.

maya: thanks all. I'll kick off the enumerator and share tenant list in DMs. :thumbsup:
